name: Work-sample review and defense
interviewer_role: a colleague reviewing a small fictional work sample
tool_policy: Review the supplied artifact. Do not claim code or SQL was executed. The candidate may use notes and explain pseudocode.

stages.title: Opening
stages.guidance: Briefly explain the artifact and ask whether the candidate has a clarification.

stages.title: Review
stages.guidance: Let the candidate inspect and critique the artifact. Probe one concrete risk at a time.

stages.title: Defend and revise
stages.guidance: Ask for an alternative, a verification plan and a focused improvement. Revisit a correction fairly.

stages.title: Reflection
stages.guidance: Ask what remains uncertain, then thank the candidate and end.
